description: A Python script demonstrating audio recording with Pipecat, including setup for audio streams, saving merged and individual audio tracks, and integrating various AI services (STT, TTS, LLM).

classes.name: AudioBufferProcessor
classes.description: Handles audio buffering and provides events for merged and track-specific audio data.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the processing pipeline for conversation, speech recognition, and synthesis.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with parameters and execution controls.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of the pipeline, including signal handling.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Maintains context for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Aggregates context for user and assistant interactions.

classes.name: OpenAILLMService
classes.description: Language model service using OpenAI GPT-4.

methods.name: save_audio_file
methods.description: Saves audio bytes to a WAV file with specified sample rate and channels.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the audio recording and processing pipeline with event handlers.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point to initialize transport and start the bot.
